_comment: easyClaude's own verify contract. The framework should run under its own gate; if the validator is red, no turn here should be allowed to end claiming otherwise.
_tier_comment: The validator is fast and runs on every turn. The test suite for the checking machinery takes around 25 seconds - too slow for a per-turn gate, and it only matters when the checking machinery itself changes - so it is full tier: it runs at the end of a task and in CI, not after every edit.
